title: Wiseman fails to replicate Sheldrake's psychic dog experiments
summary: Michael Shermer tells of Wiseman fails to replicate Sheldrake's psychic dog experiments, about an unknown time at England, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So Richard Wisman tried to conduct the exact same experiments with the dog and he's published these and he gets no results.

plain: Michael Shermer, a researcher known as a skeptic, says on Jesse Michels' podcast that Rupert Sheldrake ran experiments in England suggesting a dog could sense things it had no ordinary way of knowing. Shermer says another researcher, Richard Wiseman, ran the exact same experiments, published them, and got no results, which in his view undercuts the claim that such psychic powers are real.
